page.notes: Some entries in the lower left column and the cut-off lines at the bottom of the middle and right columns are faint or blurred; readings there are best effort. Possible misreadings: "Abrhamus" (Abhamus?), "Alexandri Albinus ... in Galliam" final line, and the numbers in "Ambeikeigitus" and "Ambianensis" entries. Page numbers in the right column are unclear. The Ambianensis line is printed with "crudeltas" and is transcribed as printed-looking "crudelitas" with doubt. Several lines are only partly legible, mainly the page references and the places where ink is faint; these are marked [?] in the entries. The top line is cut short at the start of this part. Bottom of the page: three short columns of index entries run together with the right column; the left and middle columns are read first, then the right. Top line of the right column is cut, so its wording is partly doubtful and marked [?]. Several entries are uncertain in their wording and numbers, notably the Andreas Formanus and Angliquomodo lines and the Alexander entries at the foot.
